On-device OCR for photographed certs (loaded only when a photo is chosen).
- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), see LICENSE-tesseract.js.txt
- tesseract-core-*-lstm.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), see LICENSE-tesseract-core.txt
- eng.traineddata.gz: Tesseract English LSTM model, 4.0.0_best_int, via @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (Apache-2.0 model from tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best)
